summary: The JSON pretty-printing feature is implemented but untested: I was told not to run tests or code, so the new test expectations were derived by reading the code, not executed. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; six json.* theme entries in rich/default_styles.py; the JSON renderable and __main__ entry in new rich/json.py; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; new tests test_print_json (tests/test_console.py) and test_rich_print_json (tests/test_rich_print.py); a "Printing JSON" docs section in docs/source/console.rst; new docs/source/reference/json.rst with a toctree entry in reference.rst; and a CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased. Nothing was committed. Design choices: overflow is set to None, the CLI path metavar is PATH, and the hex number form is tried before decimal digits. Next step: run the test suite to confirm the expected ANSI output in test_print_json.
